notes.title: May News - Major Update - New Inventory - Weapon/Ability Upgrades and more.
notes.content:
[u][b]Where to find us:[/b][/u]
Official website [b][url=www.littlebyte.com.au]www.littlebyte.com.au[/url][/b] 
Follow us on socials
Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/LBGameStudio]HERE[/url]
Facebook [url=https://www.facebook.com/littlebytegamestudio/]HERE[/url]
LinkedIn [url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/littlebyte-games-631761219/]HERE[/url]

This is a development update for Lost Assassin - A Tale of AI Corruption - Changes in this devlog will be in the next update coming soon. 
Many of the changes and additions have been added after a period of play and feedback we have been provided with. We make regular dev videos on our Twitter account to give that a follow to keep up with minor updates.

In the new update, we have added many new features as mentioned in the previous news update. Well, now it's all available! 

Here's a summary of what is now available:

[b]Player[/b] – The player has had another review to improve the overall ‘flow and feel’ of gameplay. 
- More advanced player controller as seen in games like Hollow Knight and Celeste. Added coyote time, jump buffering, maximum fall speed, airtime, and gravity manipulation. This gives the player a much snappier and responsive feel. 
•	Improved jumping and general movement
•	New horizontal dash for getting to places faster or evading the challenging new enemy projectiles. The dash uses jetpack fuel very quickly but will be upgradeable. 
•	Crouch – Will be useful for taking cover against several hazards and possibly shooting through gaps. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/2c8001c411159b410f038ac40c1d1f4b27ac592a.png[/img]

[b]Enemy AI and Physics[/b] - Several big changes to enemy AI. 
•	New improved hit scanning. Now if a ranged attack enemy sees the player, it will be able to aim directly at the player. This makes for a much more realistic combat experience and less chance of exploiting the enemies. 
•	Changes to enemy speeds to be more varied and difficult

[b]Inventory System[/b] – - Added grid-based inventory system that allows you to store and manage items. You can also upgrade weapon damage, fire rate, and reload speed straight from your inventory. More upgrades are planned for the future. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/922a0e054e0085fe13274263d8268a5c434b14bc.png[/img]
[b]Level Design[/b] – Chapter 2 is still in the works. We go even deeper into this cave biome and discover some new mining resources. There will be some interesting platforming and puzzles to solve and possibly some new enemies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/1bf32040285b0fb624738f319e14f72694a1d4e1.png[/img]

[b]Shaders and Effects[/b] - Added new shader and post processing effects for player buffs. Also, camera shake for explosions. 
 [b]Grenade Shrapnel[/b] - Added shrapnel for frag and bouncy grenades that fly out when the grenades explode and deal damage to anything within the blast area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/8140c7fd8ab0e47bb068e937f53694351bc1bbb0.png[/img]

notes.title: Alpha 3.0 Available Now! - Ground-Up Reboot Ready to Play Chapter 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/a1cce96d910a5598b882882a0bd0f988cc59b91c.png[/img]

A new beginning for the Assassin! We are excited to announce the new [b]rebooted project[/b] is available to play!  

https://youtu.be/kzg-Mwc4kss

[b]Re-download and see our much improved gameplay, graphics and more. [/b]

[u][b]Alpha Build 3.0 - Features[/b][/u]

[b]Greatly Improved Graphics [/b]- Remade Vector Sprites, Particle Effects and Lighting. You will hardly recognise the new game from the old one since we revised 99% of the graphical assets. Environments have many new textures and much higher detail illustrations. All made by us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/9214328430fc90cfdfd624e6189b77a2e8fd213a.jpg[/img]

[b]Gameplay [/b]- The aim is to strike a balance between combat and exploration. You will find in this level, a variety of gameplay styles mashed together. This is always a balancing act, and we will continie to work on gameplay balance.

[list]
[*] Combat: Accurate shooting and use of objects is essential to your survival 
[*] Exploration: Search every corner for mineable resources, loot, and secrets. We want to reward searching and this will be developed much further in the next update. 
[*] Puzzles and Physics: Currently there are a few basic puzzles that will make your journey easier. We want to further develop the use of physics objects to solve problems. 
[*] Crafting Stations: There are currently 2 types of mineral to use in the crafting stations placed in 3 locations. Currently you can craft a couple of ammo types, but this mechanism will be greatly expanded upon to feature all kinds of items. Some will be exclusive to crafting stations. 
[*] Barrel Stations: There are several fuel barrel vending machines in the level that may assist you if there are gems to spend. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/167010884297516ea7bdb9d8b94c8e0e34ec917f.jpg[/img]

[b]Revised Character Animations -[/b] All characters are animated using bone rigging for much more lifelike movement. Ragdoll physics also lead to some hilarious deaths. The player model has been completely re-animated and designed to have more fluid movement. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/463401975c8794968fdc02490b6ef9e31e88da3d.png[/img]

[b]Weapons[/b] - Every weapon has been remade to be more satisfying and visceral. The Mining Gun is now the Prospector Tool and features the ability to tether and throw certain objects. This is extremely handy in tight situation. (Not all weapons are available yet as they are discovered in later levels soon!) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/dc66f601f0df6ca4962e1aa65c82f452dd404acf.jpg[/img]

[b]Level Design[/b] - Currently we have one long sprawling level that is the pilot for the rest of the campaign. We will have 7 levels by final release, each with unique, hand crafted caves, structures machines and enemies. 

[b]Enemy AI [/b]- Instead of pre-scripted enemies that patrol on set paths, we have been developing 'free roaming' enemy AI from scratch that respond to their situation in a variety of ways. This is very much a work in progress and many features are yet to be added. Each enemy has parameters we can adjust and what you will find is a lot of 'randomness' to how they behave, and [b]each playthrough will be different.[/b]. There are quirks to this kind of system, but we believe it will make from a far more interesting experience in the long run if we continue in this direction. There will be several tiers of enemy, each with thier own set of behaviours and strengths. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/389420e156026ee28c8f0930115b9e82ed2055db.jpg[/img]

[b]NPC AI [/b]- We currently have a single AI human at the beginning named Lisa. She is our prototype AI and as you will see, can pack some heat! In coming levels, we will have 'helper' survivors appear in certain high resistance areas. (Word inside: There is also a helper drone vending machine in development)

notes.title: May Dev Updates - First Chapter Complete - New Mineables - Stores
notes.content:
We are hoping to make the first Early Access installment of the game available very soon (possibly within days) and have held off a little so the player experience is as bug free and enjoyable as possible. We have been extremely busy adding new mechanics that will set the tone for the entire player campaign and the planned 7 levels. 

[u][b]Where to find us:[/b][/u]
Official website [b][url=www.littlebyte.com.au]www.littlebyte.com.au[/url][/b] 
Follow us on socials
Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/LBGameStudio]HERE[/url]
Facebook [url=https://www.facebook.com/littlebytegamestudio/]HERE[/url]
LinkedIn [url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/littlebyte-games-631761219/]HERE[/url]


This update will go into some more depth on what to expect with the new re-launched version of Lost Assassin - A Tale of AI Corruption

[b]Enemy AI and Physics[/b] - We have made even more improvements to enemy AI including some more melee for lower level grunts, some screen shake effects, pathfinding and placement. There is also a new hit detection indicator that shows if you have damaged their body (white flash) or head (red flash). 

[b]Level Design[/b] - This has been our focus. To make a long sprawling level with a variety of gameplay elements. Taking inspiration from a variety of great games like Metroid, Half Life and even Dead Space.. Along with the combat, we have taken inspiration from many 'mining' genre games with some switches, traps and physics object thrown into the mix. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/32dabdfca1744a063ba258fdd62e02c1839a1da5.jpg[/img]

[b]Object Spawners/Stores[/b] - We now have some interesting new interactive devices in the map. First is a barrel spawner that costs 25gems per barrel. Pull the lever and it creates a barrel to use in either destroying rocks or to hurl at an enemy! The second one is a new 'crafting machine' similar to the ones in Prey that allows the player to spend minerals on ammo and supplies. You will only be able to afford a few early in the game, so spend wisely! The weapons are powerful but so are the stronger enemies you will encounter so we want the player to only use them when all other options are exhausted. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/167010884297516ea7bdb9d8b94c8e0e34ec917f.jpg[/img]

[b]New Mineable Mineral[/b] - We now have Iron to be mined alongside the existing '5aia gems'. There were always plans to create a variety of mineable minerals in this campaign with the intent to have some basic 'crafting' stores. This is still in development, but you will have to decide what supplies will suit your playstyle a litte more as resources are scarce. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/d76bab15b66534b73bd6812244413560af437092.png[/img]

[b]Player[/b] - Improvements to the animations for our main character. There is still some work to be done, but it appears more lifelike and flows with the gameplay nicely. 

[b]NPC AI[/b] (early stages of development) - There are a couple of human characters in the first chapter now. We hope to add many more NPC's that will serve a variety of roles. The first encounter the player has is 'Lisa', who is trapped with some grunts in the cave entrance. Fortunately, Lisa is a force to be reckoned with and has no problem showing off her target seeking abilities with her pistol. If they get in close she will pull out a knife. We have always wanted AI that is autonomous and not scripted to appear as though it's intelligent, but more reactive to situations of it's own accord. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/389420e156026ee28c8f0930115b9e82ed2055db.jpg[/img]

It's quite a lot more complex to create AI with ranged/melee attacks that engage with other AI than player vs AI, but we hope to expand upon this AI by having 'helper drones' you can spend resources on that would assist you in challenging sections.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/be5a4f409b958bf83975bfc828b3064c83959ffb.jpg[/img]


[b]Shaders and Effects[/b] - We have some physics molten lava and 2D reflective water in the level now. The lava is actually an important part of chapter 1's gameplay that you will have to wait and see. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/9214328430fc90cfdfd624e6189b77a2e8fd213a.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned and don't forget to give us a wishlist. We are a team of two, so it all counts!

notes.title: April Development Updates - Enemy AI, Level Design and Prospector Tool
notes.content:
This update is to provide some details on what to expect when we begin the first major phase of our relaunch. We promised an update in Q1 but have decided to hold off a bit longer while we refine the opening stage.

This update will go into some more depth on what to expect with the new relaunched version of Lost Assassin - A Tale of AI Corruption

[u][b]Enemy AI and Physics[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/303b21711f892c480f2d1ae17b6bd1db69719101.png[/img]

This past month, we have been further improving the enemy AI to feature more responsiveness to the environment. More dynamic 'decision making' on platforms and refinement to the different behaviour modes (idle, patrolling, chasing/engaged). If you shoot an enemy, they will begin to chase you and negotiate the terrain in a more realistic way by jumping and dropping down from ledges. 


[previewyoutube=gRMzLIHAZD0;full][/previewyoutube]



[b]Level Design and the Prospector Tool[/b] - This has been the main focus of late. Our aim is to create an interesting and challenging opening level. Now some solid AI enemies have been created, we are developing a level that makes the most of them. We are also leaning into puzzle platforming elements with some physics based areas that utilise the Prospector Tool to pick up and move items. Since you will not have an arsenal of weapons to begin with, the prospector tool will be your main 'weapon'. Don't worry, there will be plenty of ways to cause chaos. 


[previewyoutube=rVTWWUsBhkg;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Humans[/b] (early stages of development) - We have been wanting to include autonimous NPCs who will engage in combat with the enemy if they are encountered. So far it's still in early stages, but it looks promising. We will have NPCs as characters in the main story that assist in providing objectives etc. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/be5a4f409b958bf83975bfc828b3064c83959ffb.jpg[/img]


[b]Shaders and Effects[/b]
Refinements and changes to various effects in explosions and pickups etc.


[b]Gems[/b] - There are now special rare gems that provide large numbers of gems when mined. 

Stay tuned and don't forget to give us a wislist. We are a team of two so it all counts!

notes.title: March Development Updates - New Enemy AI, Physics and UI
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/1b94f01080518ff088cbf621a1ab82a64e1e4784.png[/img]This update is to provide some details on what to expect when we begin the first major phase of our relaunch. The first update will be available Q1 2023 so please add to your [b]wishlist! [/b]

[u][b]Where to find us:[/b][/u]
Official website [b][url=www.littlebyte.com.au]www.littlebyte.com.au[/url][/b] 
Follow us on socials
Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/LBGameStudio]HERE[/url]
Facebook [url=https://www.facebook.com/littlebytegamestudio/]HERE[/url]

This update will go into some more depth on what to expect with the new relaunched version of Lost Assassin. 

[u][b]Enemy AI and Physics[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/303b21711f892c480f2d1ae17b6bd1db69719101.png[/img]

We have spent a great deal of time improving the enemies to be more autonomous and reactive to the player. We hope to create an experience that is full of random encounters and unexpected behavior. Combining the elements of: New Animations, physics and AI coding, we are very excited to show off these new enemies very soon. 

Previously the enemies were similar to what you would expect in most platformers as in they would have a set path to patrol and if you entered their area they would attack. Now we have introduced some new behaviors to allow for more variation in gameplay. Below are some features: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/2429e8fddab60b2241ac84ce0b1ea1cfebaa364a.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Differing personality types[/b] - Behavior can range from brave to cowardly. How they react to attacks will be determined on a range of factors that are premade but not obvious to the player.
[*] [b]Some drop from ledges[/b] when alerted to pursuit the player.
[*][b] Charging at the player[/b] - Some will rush at you when you enter their area. 
[*][b] Evasion[/b] - Some will try to preserve their own life when health reaches a certain point and will run from the player.
[*] [b]Jumping over objects[/b] - Some will scan objects and jump over them. This will hopefully allow for a great deal of variation in the gameplay. 
[*] [b]Turn the direction of player if taking damage[/b] - Previously you could sometimes spam an enemy before they turn around. Not anymore. 
[*] [b]Some aiming improvements[/b] - Rocket Launcher enemies have the ability to aim in your direction and react accordingly. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/26587a0c2e6f5e476d7d33c27478b3a5a1a2f570.jpg[/img]

[b]Humans[/b] (early stages of development) - We are also developing some inhabitants who will exist in the environment, fighting for their own survival, helping you with storyline, objective locations tips and possibly some combat assistance. So far we have simple male and female characters with basic survival accessories. Here's the male character. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/152f66e69d6eedbe8376ab0ef75dcf2353f91b96.jpg[/img]

[b]UI and items - Revision[/b]

We decided that the old UI simply did not pass the eye test when combined with all the new assets. So a complete remake was conducted. This time, we used vector image making tools to create some much more refined and clean icons. The result is more consistency throughout the game and everything is much easier to read. Here's some examples below. 

[b]Pickup Containers[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/fecbe5b1a27cc5c54b62279ff7551527b38adf4c.jpg[/img]

[b]UI Icons[/b]: Life - Jetpack - Equiped Grenade - Torch
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/10b022f4be68db19f3ace7e3e9a6c279fb8bb890.jpg[/img]

[b]Gems[/b] - We have made gems more varying in size and shape. They are the main collectible item in the game that will serve as a currency for upgrades and also ammo for one of the later game weapons. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/1ee15dae3181247940223f67267d8464c736179f.png[/img]

notes.title: Relaunch Coming Q1 2023 - Ground up overhaul of Lost Assassin
notes.content:
This update is to provide some details on what to expect when we begin the first major phase of our [b]relaunch[/b]. The first update will be available Q1 2023!

Where to find us:
Follow our official Twitter for videos and development news [url=https://twitter.com/LBGameStudio]HERE[/url]
and Facebook [url=https://www.facebook.com/littlebytegamestudio]HERE[/url]
We have also updated the website [url=https://littlebyte.com.au/]www.littlebyte.com.au[/url] that will feature more updates on this title and some other interesting projects.

Lost Assassin: Relaunch Details
Although the game we previously created was somewhat OK for a team of two people, we were unhappy with the overall 'look' of the game and the rudimentary elements of the graphics, physics and features. We had lots of feedback and have taken it on board. 

As this was the first time we have attempted to make a game available for purchase, there was much to learn. But now we have a great deal more experience and want to bring an all new Lost Assassin that is much closer to what we envisioned in the beginning. 

So below are some of the things to expect when we drop a new update Q1 2023 (TBC)

The update will essentially be a small playable set of 1 or 2 completely new levels. Here is a list of changes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/1b94f01080518ff088cbf621a1ab82a64e1e4784.png[/img]

[u]General Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Updated Sprites and Textures - Reviewed and updated anything that didn't meet the new standards
[*] UI completely remade - Looks much more theme specific and futuristic
[/list]

[u]Player and Enemies[/u]
[list]
[*] Rebuilt jumping and jetpack mechanics - More fluid movement and momentum.
[*] First round of new enemies  - 'Corrupted Humans' - rigged, animated and improved AI
[*] All new weapons and some attacks animations for enemies, recoil animations. 
[*] Some enemies now have close and long range attacks. 
[*] All new enemy type: Flamer Hulk (name TBC) - Flame thrower - gas tank back can be damaged, killing him upon explosion.
[*] All new physics system including ragdoll deaths.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/303b21711f892c480f2d1ae17b6bd1db69719101.png[/img]

[u]Weapons[/u]
[list]
[*] New alt fire for Prospector Tool: Pick up and droppable objects. Damage enemies with objects.
[*] Added charged weapon - 'Bolt Launcher'
[*] Improved overall weapon balance and functionality
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/e1d5fe6d6cc82ac706cfa64cbdded3bf42b99f0a.jpg[/img]

[u]Environments and Objects[/u]
[list]
[*] Greatly Improved visuals using 2D shader effects and lighting.
[*] More variation in maps and environments.
[*] Water and lava pools
[*] Exploding barrels! (every shooter needs exploding barrels right?)
[*] Destructible blocks - Improvements with player interaction 
[*] Many objects have weight, can be moved/thrown. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/164b34d076223ef48e4eb9b11514c54f19a33e55.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Class 1: Corrupted Humans - New Enemy Character Designs - Ragdoll Physics
notes.content:
[b]Class 1 - 'Corrupted Human'[/b] characters have been created and are finalising their testing phase. 

[b]The most notable point:[/b] We have moved away from premade frame-by-frame animation and instead regged them inside Unity which allows much more flexibility in how they behave. Along with looking much better than before, they are far more realistic in movement. 

The new character designs and animation compliments the existing coding and AI that had been programmed by Michael, and brings the overall gaming experience into a new level of quality that previously was not present. We cannot wait to show some clips of them in action! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/303b21711f892c480f2d1ae17b6bd1db69719101.png[/img]

We currently have four of the 'Corrupted Human' class enemies rigged up and animated with some more to be added at a later date. 

Fully poseable characters with much more lifelike movement
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/1e5f2cf6defa11cdb1052965fce081f11cf59bfd.png[/img]


Next will be some enemies of the robotic variety Some will be humanoid and late game will include some very tough Mechs. All the AI is ready and character design in in the works right now. I can show a sneak peek wireframe design..

{Classified Concept Image} 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/f6189aba415851e86ba5d46efce4388a31b3b9d8.jpg[/img]


Happy new year and join us for more updates soon!

notes.title: We're back - Big Changes Incoming
notes.content:
It's been a minute since we have updated Lost Assassin. There has been some developments!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/055fc42eeda7046bda80b1a4c0ac9996c86cee73.jpg[/img]

In the past couple of months, life has given us the chance to come back and review the state of the game and plan on a full relaunch. Being a small team of two means the most valuable resource is time. Covid (work related committments due to Covid) really took the life out of game dev, but we are back! 

Below you will find some info on what to expect in the coming months with Lost Assassin. 

[b]Simpler and Refined Gameplay: [/b]

[list]
[*] There are things the game was doing well and things that were basically buggy or broken. We are stripping back the game to a simpler and more refined linear game with an emphasis on the gunplay and exploration elements. Redesiging levels to be more rewarding to play and visually appealing. 
[/list]

[b]More refined enemy AI and appearance[/b]

[list]
[*] AI: The enemies were problematic to use in many settings. Micheal has been working very hard at creating more stable enemies which will provide a richer and more immersive experience for the player. 

[*] Appearance: I am aiming to reimport all enemies, weapons, icons and the main player models to be more in line with where we want them to be. The biggest change will be the use of Unity bones animation instead of importing sprite sequences. This will create a much more natural look and feel to the animations.  

[b]Fun fact! This player model revision will be the 4th iteration! [/b]
[/list]

[b]Remaking all levels[/b]

[list]
[*] This is a big one. We were relatively happy with the levels, but in recent years Unity has introduced some added features to 2D mode so we are very excited on the possibilities. I am currently designing some levels with a much more natural and flowing look when compared to the current blocky style. There is really no comparison between the old and new levels that are coming. I am also adding higher quality textures and have been learning a lot more about the art of creating levels with set themes. 
[*] 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/38f86f205ed0a059020bc08d3b3ac17e8db27357.jpg[/img]
Current Levels use the older 9 slice which is limiting in what shapes are possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39813527/18c5dfb58e0dd3cd07e1ccdf9bb4dea93be2d44e.jpg[/img]
New Levels are more flowing and natural looking

[b]
Story Plot[/b]
[list]
